blocks.raw: The fifteen standard SVGs in this directory are preserved from LVRS commit `29399482`, before subsequent Figma icon recoloring. `panHand.svg` and `translateObject.svg` come from the preserved Vincent source at `Product/.Deprecated/Vincent/src/App/resources/icons`. This app embeds these vectors at build time so SDK theme updates do not change the restored editor. The existing LVRS and third-party icon license notices remain part of the native bundle.
The eraser's gold and the shapes' neutral gray are restored to the preserved editor screenshot palette; their original vector geometry is retained.
